repos.description: π RuView turns commodity WiFi signals into real-time spatial intelligence, vital sign monitoring, and presence detection — all without a single pixel of video.
repos.summary_zh: RuView利用商用WiFi的CSI信道状态信息，通过物理信号处理和机器学习实现穿墙人体感知。系统提供实时姿态估计(54K fps)、呼吸心率监测及毫秒级存在检测，无需摄像头或穿戴设备。基于Rust构建，支持ESP32-S3等低成本硬件，适用于智能安防、健康监护及灾难救援等隐私敏感场景。
repos.summary_en: RuView transforms commodity WiFi CSI signals into real-time human perception through physics-based signal processing and ML. It delivers 54K fps pose estimation, vital sign monitoring (breathing/heartbeat), and <1ms presence detection without cameras or wearables. Built in Rust with 1100+ tests, it supports ESP32-S3 and research NICs for through-wall sensing up to 5m. Ideal for privacy-preserving smart home, healthcare, security, and disaster response applications.

repos.description: Lightweight server monitoring with historical data, docker stats, and alerts.
repos.summary_zh: Beszel 是一款基于 PocketBase 的轻量级服务器监控平台，采用 hub-agent 架构。它提供 Docker 容器资源统计、历史数据追踪和自定义告警功能，支持多用户管理、OAuth 认证与自动备份。相比主流方案资源占用更低，具备友好 Web 界面，开箱即用，适合个人及小型团队监控物理服务器、虚拟机和容器化环境。
repos.summary_en: Beszel is a lightweight server monitoring platform built on PocketBase using a hub-agent architecture. It tracks Docker container metrics, historical data, and configurable alerts while supporting multi-user management, OAuth authentication, and automatic backups. With significantly lower resource consumption than leading solutions and an intuitive web interface, it's ideal for individuals and small teams monitoring physical servers, VMs, and containerized environments.

repos.description: Why is this running? Trace any process, port, container, or file back to what started it - CLI + TUI.
repos.summary_zh: witr是一款跨平台系统诊断工具，专为回答“为什么在运行”而生。它通过CLI或交互式TUI，一键追溯任意进程、端口、容器或文件的完整启动因果链，覆盖systemd、Docker、PM2等监督层，输出人类可读报告或JSON，补全传统ps/lsof工具的因果盲区，助力运维与排障。
repos.summary_en: witr is a cross-platform diagnostic CLI+TUI tool that answers “Why is this running?”. It traces any process, port, container or file back to its full startup causality chain—including supervisors like systemd, Docker and PM2—delivering human-readable output or machine-readable JSON in one command, filling the gap left by traditional tools like ps and lsof.

repos.description: Open-source intelligence for the global theater. Track everything from the corporate/private jets of the wealthy, and spy satellites, to seismic events in one unified interface. Hook an AI agent up to have it parse through data and find previously unseen correlations. The knowledge is available to all but rarely aggregated in the open, until now.
repos.summary_zh: ShadowBroker是实时多域开源情报平台，聚合60+公开数据源包括航班ADS-B、船舶AIS、卫星遥测及地震信息。基于Next.js与MapLibre GL构建交互式地图，支持35+数据层切换与右键地理情报查询。采用自托管架构确保隐私，面向分析师提供全球威胁监控与研究工作。
repos.summary_en: ShadowBroker is a real-time OSINT platform aggregating 60+ public data sources including aircraft ADS-B, maritime AIS, satellite telemetry and seismic events. Built with Next.js and MapLibre GL, it provides 35+ interactive data layers and geospatial analysis tools. Self-hosted deployment ensures privacy for analysts tracking global threats and conducting open-source intelligence research.

repos.description: 京东抢购自动下单助手，GUI 支持 Windows 和 macOS
repos.summary_zh: 京东小猪手是Python开发的跨平台自动抢购助手，核心功能包括7x24小时库存监听、自动下单及微信通知。支持扫码登录与预售定金模式，提供Windows/macOS图形界面，简化配置流程。采用SKU/AreaID精准定位商品与配送区域，适用于秒杀、缺货商品监控等场景，提升抢购成功率。
repos.summary_en: JdBuyer is a Python-based cross-platform automation assistant for JD.com flash sales. It provides 24/7 stock monitoring, automatic order placement, and WeChat notifications. The tool features QR code login, GUI support for Windows/macOS, and handles pre-sale deposits. Users configure SKU/AreaID for precise targeting, making it effective for seckill events and out-of-stock tracking, giving regular buyers equal opportunity against automated scalpers.

repos.description: Autonomous penetration testing using a swarm of AI agents. Orchestrates recon, classification, exploitation, and reporting specialists with ReAct reasoning — supports bug bounty, continuous monitoring, and CTF modes. Built with Go and 7+ native security tools.
repos.summary_zh: Pentest Swarm AI是首个基于真实群体架构的开源渗透测试工具，通过AI代理群协同完成侦察、分类、利用和报告全流程。支持漏洞赏金、持续监控和CTF模式，集成nmap、sqlmap、Burp等7+原生安全工具，兼容Claude、Ollama等多种大模型，采用ReAct推理实现真正自主化的安全测试。
repos.summary_en: Pentest Swarm AI is the first open-source penetration testing tool built on a real swarm architecture, orchestrating specialized AI agents for reconnaissance, classification, exploitation, and reporting. Supporting bug bounty programs, continuous monitoring, and CTF competitions, it integrates 7+ native security tools including nmap, sqlmap, Burp, and Metasploit. Built with Go and ReAct reasoning, it's compatible with Claude, Ollama, and other LLMs, enabling truly autonomous security testing through stigmergic multi-agent coordination.

repos.description: Google Antigravity AI模型配额监控插件 (Antigravity AI Model Quota Watching)
repos.summary_zh: AntigravityQuotaWatcher 是一款 VS Code 插件，专为 Antigravity AI 平台用户提供实时配额监控。通过自动检测服务端口与认证信息，在状态栏直观展示各模型剩余配额，并在配额不足时智能预警。内置 Dashboard 面板支持配额概览、连接状态检测及周限测试，帮助开发者有效管理 AI 资源，避免开发中断。
repos.summary_en: AntigravityQuotaWatcher is a VS Code extension that provides real-time quota monitoring for Antigravity AI platform users. It automatically detects service ports and authentication credentials, displays remaining quotas for various AI models in the status bar, and offers smart alerts when quotas are low. The built-in Dashboard panel provides quota overview, connection status, and weekly limit testing features, helping developers effectively manage AI resources and prevent development interruptions.

repos.description: A golang implementation of endlessh (SSH tarpit) exporting Prometheus metrics, visualized by a Grafana dashboard.
repos.summary_zh: 基于Go实现的SSH tarpit（endlessh），通过故意延迟响应浪费暴力破解攻击者时间，并导出Prometheus指标，配合Grafana仪表板可视化攻击源地理位置与统计数据。适用于SSH安全防护与威胁情报场景，支持Docker部署、GeoIP查询、健康检查，轻量高效且可观测性强。
repos.summary_en: A Golang implementation of endlessh (SSH tarpit) that delays responses to waste brute-force attackers' time while exporting Prometheus metrics, visualized via a Grafana dashboard showing geolocations and attack statistics. Ideal for SSH defense and threat intelligence, with Docker support, GeoIP lookup, and health checks.

repos.description: Vocat is an open-source web control panel and engineering toolkit for Quectel EC20/EC25-class cellular modems. It combines modem discovery, live radio status, AT and USSD terminals, SMS, WiFi Calling, eSIM management, network selection, proxy routing, notifications, audit logs, and release automation in one self-contained service.
repos.summary_zh: Vocat 是开源的移远 EC20/EC25 蜂窝模组 Web 管理面板，集成模组发现、射频监控、AT/USSD 终端、短信、WiFi Calling、eSIM 管理、网络选择与代理路由，Go+React 单二进制部署，支持多架构 Docker。
repos.summary_en: Vocat is an open-source web control panel for Quectel EC20/EC25 cellular modems, integrating modem discovery, radio monitoring, AT/USSD terminals, SMS, WiFi Calling, eSIM management, network selection, and proxy routing. Built with Go and React, it deploys as a single binary with multi-arch Docker support.

repos.description: Realm 全功能一键中转脚本，终端可视化界面构建网络转发服务.Realm: Full-featured one-click network relay — configure and manage forwarding rules from an interactive TUI.
repos.summary_zh: 纯Shell脚本实现的Realm全功能网络中转管理工具，提供交互式TUI界面一键配置转发规则。同步官方最新特性（TCP/UDP、WS/WSS/TLS隧道、MPTCP、多入口多出口、Proxy Protocol），并扩展负载均衡、故障转移、端口流量监控限速与网络链路测试，支持多发行版与离线安装，极简高效搭建中转服务器。
repos.summary_en: A pure Shell-script tool for full-featured Realm network relay management with an interactive TUI. Syncs all official Realm capabilities (TCP/UDP, WS/WSS/TLS tunnels, MPTCP, multi-entry/exit, Proxy Protocol) and adds load balancing, failover, port traffic monitoring/limiting, and link testing. Supports multiple distros and offline install for lightweight relay server setup.

repos.description: Visibility into AI agent activity on endpoints, with on-device detection, optional pre-action blocking, and forensic reconstruction.
repos.summary_zh: numbat 是 PerplexityAI 开发的端点可见性工具，专注于 AI 智能体在桌面、CLI、IDE 和网关上的活动监控。通过本地钩子、插件、OTLP/HTTP 日志和磁盘会话 artifact 观察，将数据归一化为统一事件模型，由本地 CEL 规则引擎进行检测。支持实时监控、多步序列规则、可选预行动阻断、取证重建、机密红化 NDJSON 记录，以及库存、时间线和案例打包工具。以单静态二进制分发至 macOS、Linux、Windows，强调本地处理与隐私保护，适用于 AI 智能体部署的安全监控、合规与取证场景。
repos.summary_en: Numbat is a PerplexityAI endpoint visibility tool focused on monitoring AI agent activity across desktop, CLI, IDE, and gateway platforms. It observes agents via local hooks, plugins, OTLP/HTTP logs, and on-disk session artifacts, normalizing events into a unified model evaluated by a local CEL rule engine. Features include live monitoring, multi-step sequence rules, opt-in pre-action blocking, forensic reconstruction from artifacts, secret-redacted NDJSON records, and tools for inventory, timelines, and portable case bundles. Distributed as a single static binary for macOS, Linux, and Windows, it emphasizes local processing and privacy for security monitoring, compliance, and forensics in AI agent deployments.

repos.description: 一个透明的 Tavily API 反向代理：将多个 Tavily API Key（额度/credits）汇聚在一个 Master Key 之后，并提供内置 Web UI 用于管理 Key、用量与请求日志。
repos.summary_zh: TavilyProxyManager 是一个专为 Tavily API 设计的高可用代理网关，核心解决多 API Key 的额度聚合与智能调度问题。通过 Master Key 统一鉴权，实现基于剩余额度的动态负载均衡与自动故障切换，有效规避频率限制。内置 Vue3 管理面板提供 Key 管理、用量监控与请求日志分析，同时集成 MCP 协议端点，无缝对接 Claude 等 AI 工具。Go 语言构建，单二进制部署，Docker 开箱即用。
repos.summary_en: TavilyProxyManager is a high-availability proxy gateway designed for Tavily API, solving multi-key quota aggregation and intelligent scheduling. It unifies authentication via Master Key, implements dynamic load balancing based on remaining credits with automatic failover to avoid rate limits. The built-in Vue3 dashboard provides key management, usage monitoring, and request log analysis, while integrated MCP protocol endpoints seamlessly connect with AI tools like Claude. Built with Go, it offers single-binary deployment and Docker-ready out-of-the-box.

repos.description: A Powerful Serverless Uptime Monitoring & Status Page on Cloudflare's Edge Network
repos.summary_zh: Uptimer是基于Cloudflare边缘网络的无服务器运行时间监控与状态页面系统。支持HTTP/TCP探测、故障事件管理、维护窗口、Webhook通知（Discord/Slack等）及管理后台，零运维部署于Workers+Pages+D1，实现实时状态展示与告警。
repos.summary_en: Uptimer is a serverless uptime monitoring and status page running on Cloudflare's edge network. It offers HTTP/TCP probes, incident management, maintenance windows, webhook alerts (Discord/Slack/etc.), and an admin dashboard, all deployed zero-ops via Workers + Pages + D1 for real-time status and notifications.

repos.description: 每天早上打开通知，高质量论文摘要已经为你准备好 Ciallo～(∠・ω< )⌒☆
repos.summary_zh: 基于LLM的学术论文自动化监控系统，每日从ArXiv及20+顶级期刊抓取最新论文，通过双模型加权评分精准筛选，深度解析PDF全文并提取创新点、方法等核心维度。自动追踪关键词趋势生成可视化报告，支持邮件/企微等多渠道推送。提供Docker、GitHub Actions等部署方案，实现零人工干预的科研情报服务。
repos.summary_en: An LLM-powered academic paper monitoring system that automatically fetches daily submissions from ArXiv and 20+ top journals. It employs dual-model weighted scoring for precise filtering, performs in-depth PDF analysis to extract key dimensions like methodologies and innovations, tracks keyword trends with visual reports, and pushes notifications via email/WeCom等多渠道. Supports Docker/GitHub Actions deployments for fully automated research intelligence.

repos.description: Open-source network quality monitoring platform with multi-node Ping, TCPing, HTTP, DNS, IPv6 and Traceroute testing.
repos.summary_zh: 开源多节点网络质量监控平台，支持Ping/TCPing/HTTP/DNS/Traceroute/IPv6探测。采用Master+Agent+RabbitMQ架构，基于RuoYi-Vue-Plus、Next.js与Prometheus Blackbox，提供Agent自动上下线、一键部署、IP地理解析及广告系统，助力企业低成本搭建网络运维与测速平台。
repos.summary_en: Open-source multi-node network quality monitoring platform supporting Ping, TCPing, HTTP, DNS, Traceroute and IPv6. Built with Master+Agent+RabbitMQ architecture using RuoYi-Vue-Plus, Next.js and Prometheus Blackbox. Features auto Agent management, one-click deployment, IP geolocation and ad system for low-cost enterprise network ops.

repos.description: An AI-assisted newsroom workflow system for event tracking, evidence organization, approval chains, correction handling, and post-publication monitoring.
repos.summary_zh: NewsFlow 是一款 AI 辅助的新闻编辑室工作流系统，专注于新闻生产中高成本、高责任的中间流程。系统通过 AI 智能体实现线索归并、证据结构化、风险审查、签发审批和发布后监测，建立完整的人机协同审核机制。采用 FastAPI+React 技术栈，支持自托管和二次开发，为新闻机构提供可审计、可追溯的数字化协作平台。
repos.summary_en: NewsFlow is an AI-assisted newsroom workflow system focusing on the high-cost, high-responsibility intermediate processes of news production. It employs AI agents to handle lead clustering, evidence structuring, risk assessment, approval chains, and post-publication monitoring, establishing a comprehensive human-in-the-loop review mechanism. Built with FastAPI+React stack, it supports self-hosting and secondary development, providing news organizations with an auditable, traceable digital collaboration platform for editorial governance and fact-checking workflows.

repos.description: TypeScript SDK for the NitroPing audit log — batching client, error capture, Hono/Express/Nitro adapters, and GenAI cost tracing.
repos.summary_zh: nitroping-sdk 是 nitroping.dev 平台的官方多语言客户端库，支持 TypeScript、Swift、Python、Go、Kotlin、PHP 等语言，封装 REST API 实现设备令牌注册（APNs/FCM/Web Push）、多渠道通知发送（推送、邮件、SMS、Slack）、定向/定时/循环推送、Web Push 订阅与 UI 组件、内置收件箱及 Webhook 验证。适用于移动/Web 应用与服务器端通知集成，提供统一 API、公私钥认证和幂等性支持，实现跨平台一致体验。
repos.summary_en: nitroping-sdk offers official client libraries for the nitroping.dev platform across TypeScript, Swift, Python, Go, Kotlin, and PHP. It wraps the REST API for device token registration (APNs/FCM/Web Push), multi-channel notifications (push, email, SMS, Slack), targeted/scheduled/recurring sends, Web Push subscriptions with UI widgets, in-app inbox, and webhook verification. Ideal for mobile/web apps and servers needing unified, secure cross-platform notification delivery with public/secret key auth and idempotency.
